scope: Exploratory prediction of certified top-form degree interval midpoint from 6 completed fixed bases (r27,r28,r30,r31,r32,r33); no elite ranking and no causal claims.

data.group: coordinate-bit base; all 48 family/m/target rows from a base stay in one fold
data.target: (dreg_lower_bound+dreg_upper_bound)/2 for finite_interval; positive_dimensional rows excluded from regression and reported separately

features: mean normalized x coordinate of those points
mean normalized y coordinate of those points
preprocessing: numeric standardization fit on training folds only; categorical one-hot; no coordinate-bit/base ID/hash/target coordinates included
model: ridge regression with intercept, alpha=10; deterministic closed-form via pure Python Gauss-Jordan elimination
validation: leave-one-coordinate-bit base out (6 folds); compare MAE to training-fold mean predictor; no tuning or refitting
metrics: grouped OOF MAE for interval midpoint

controls.positive: not applicable: predictive benchmark, no detector claim
controls.negative: not applicable: no hypothesis test or significance claim
controls.aa: not applicable: deterministic fitting; no timing claim

randomness: none; deterministic fixed folds, fixed feature list and alpha
decision: exploratory lead only if model beats baseline on at least 4 of 6 held-out bases and aggregate MAE improves; any lead remains descriptive due to only six groups and interval-midpoint proxy
inadmissible: no elite ranking, no candidate selection, no causal interpretation, no claims of global degree of regularity, no extrapolation to unmeasured coordinate bases
